Who we are

We follow the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the rules made under it.

What we collect

  • Enquiries: name, email, optional phone and organisation, the topic and your message.
  • Job and internship applications sent by email: the details and documents you choose to send.
  • Technical data: our hosting provider may keep standard server logs (IP address, browser, pages requested) for security. [Client to confirm hosting provider and log retention.]

Please send only what is relevant. Do not send passwords, bank details or identity documents unless we ask through a verified company channel.

Why we use it

To reply to your enquiry, to discuss and deliver a project you ask about, to assess applications and to keep the website secure. We do not sell personal data and do not use it for advertising.

Who processes it for us

Contact-form submissions are delivered to us through Formspree (Formspree, Inc., United States), which also filters spam. [Client to confirm the form provider and any analytics tool used.] WhatsApp, LinkedIn and Instagram have their own privacy notices that apply when you use them.

How long we keep it

[Client to confirm, e.g. enquiries 24 months after the last contact; applications 12 months; then deleted.]

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct or erase your personal data, withdraw consent, or nominate someone to act for you. Email contact@kavaiyatech.com with enough detail to identify your request. We may need to verify your identity.

Grievance contact
